candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement crediting msg.value to the caller's balance, so Acc[msg.sender].balance no longer increases after Put.
Set unlockTime unconditionally to _unlockTime instead of clamping to block.timestamp, so Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime after Put differs when _unlockTime is in the past.
Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call so Put no longer appends a message to the Log's History, changing observable Log state after Put.
Delete the statement that subtracts the withdrawn amount from the account balance after a successful call.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful collects are no longer recorded in the log.
Change the log message string from "Collect" to "Put" for collect operations.
